notes.title: 1.0.3 version update
【Mar.30 | V1.0.2 update】 Difficulty of the Endless Mode has increased!
【Mar.26 | V1.0.1 Update】Emergency fix update!
The official version of V1.0 will be launched on March 25th
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,
 
Today is a special day. The Five Masters and Disciples of Tang Monk performed multiple scenes and completed them perfectly. Just like after our day and night efforts, we are about to meet you again in the official version of V1.0 on March 25th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197405/89a2c36957254fc16e51225aa5d0afff0bceb0e7.jpg[/img]

While announcing this good news, I would like to express my gratitude to the players who have always supported our game. Whether they are players who have purchased the EA or downloaded the Demo version, without your lively discussions and suggestions, it is estimated that the game will not be released on time.

In order to express our gratitude to all the travelers to the west, we took this opportunity to hold a lottery Tang Monk took a scripture as a lottery prize. Click the link below to participate: https://www.wjx.cn/vm/rXVrE4N.aspx
[url=https://www.wjx.cn/vm/rXVrE4N.aspx]Click the link[/url]


In the Official Version of V1.0, Journey to the West Survivors will update more new content!

1. The new plot points have been greatly improved. Who will be the winner of Tang Monk’s innocent body that night? Stay tuned!
2. Optimized hero talent design and opened special unlocking methods for talents
3. Added new game combat skills to help all adventurers play more tricks
4. Added a new global damage statistics system to optimize single-game damage statistics
5. Optimized some prompt functions of the game



If you have any other suggestions for V1.0 content and future updates, please leave a message in the comment area, or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/UDTwcZdvap]DISCORD[/url] and chat with other adventurers! And we deeply realized that there are still problems with the English translation. We will keep working on it and optimize it as soon as possible. 

If you haven't added it to your wishlist yet, don't forget to add it to your wishlist. Journey to the West Survivors will become different because of you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2450100/_/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2450100/_/

notes.title: 【Feb.22 | V0.913 Update】Story is Available Now! Discover the Hidden Secrets!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44197405/16c946e8840c7b56cfa66acc0e18ea2c3b613e9e.png[/img]

1. Added stories in some levels.
2. Fixed an issue that achievements can't be unlocked;
3. Fixed an issue that Partners won't resurre;
4. Fixed an issue that some resonance may not work.
5. Decrease the difficulty of Farming & Defense mode.

We deeply realized that there are still problems about the English translation. We will keep working on it and optimize it as soon as possible. 

Thanks for you love and support to us. If you have any problem or feedback about Journey to the West Survivors, please tell us in [url=https://discord.gg/UDTwcZdvap][b]DISCORD[/b][/url].
